text:
maria_partnerships: FYI Graphcore offered an IPU v3 devkit preview (4 weeks). They want NDA, short benchmark runs, and a feedback loop. Thinking Redwood lab + remote pairing session. Who volunteers?

ravi_engineering: I can run the harness. Need to know allowed telemetry and if their profiler is okay to install in lab env.

jess_legal: Share the NDA PDF. Typical points: publication embargo, definition of Confidential Info, allowed telemetry. I'll flag anything risky.

sam_perf: Bench scope proposal: tokens/sec steady-state, p50/p95/p99 for 2k/8k seqs, memory high-water, KV cache miss rate, GEMM util. Also run the L2 quant sweep.

lin_devtools: We'll stub out a scrubber lambda to strip prompt text before upload. No raw prompt bodies leave infra. Can store perf artifacts in a private bucket `s3://redwood-eap/graphcore/ipu3`.

maria_partnerships: Graphcore said they only need aggregated counters + anonymized error traces. We'll push a telemetry artifact with no prompt contents.

ravi_engineering: Proposed timeline: week0 NDA + tooling addendum; week1 smoke + basic LLM runs; week2 benchmark set A (chat/completion); week3 tuning + quant sweep; week4 joint readout + slide deck.

sam_perf: Branch I'll create: `bench/graphcore-ipu3-eap`. Run command example:

```
./bench/run.sh --model redwood-1-medium --seq 8192 --batch 1 --trials 200 --out results/ipu3
```

Include flags: `--kv-log` and `--capture-gemm`.

lin_devtools: I'll add an ingestion script `scripts/scrub_upload.py` to remove >40 char tokens and replace emails/URLs. Also will add okta group `graphcore-eap` and generate short-lived creds for the bucket.

jess_legal: I skimmed NDA. Two changes: (1) publication embargo -> 9 months, (2) explicitly exclude prompt content from 'telemetry' language. I'll send redlines within 12h.

maria_partnerships: Good. Also check if Graphcore requires signed tool addendum for their profiler. If so, legal review needed.

ops_bot: calendar invite created: "Graphcore IPU3 EAP Kickoff" 2026-05-12 09:00 PT (https://cal.example/ipu3-kickoff).

ravi_engineering: Quick Q: do we have hardware racks ready or do they ship a single devkit that needs our bench setup?

maria_partnerships: They ship 1 devkit (rack mount). They offered optional on-site engineer for setup. Prefer remote pairing otherwise.

sam_perf: Add a small eval set (10 curated prompts) for quality regression checks post-quant. Keep it internal and ID-tagged.

lin_devtools: Will make scrubber replace any 50+ char continuous sequences with <REDACTED>. Also will log hashes for traceability (sha256).

jess_legal: If redlines accepted, expect countersign within 72h. Will also review any tool-usage terms.

maria_partnerships: Action items: @ravi create branch + initial harness (48h), @jess send NDA redlines (12h), @lin stub scrubber + RBAC (72h), @sam bench template + dashboard (72h). Update this thread with progress. :rocket:
